player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between Game room and Bar, returning to the start without exploring the unvisited "Craft room" branch fully, and I incorrectly declared "DONE" prematurely. Next time, I will maintain a strict set of visited rooms and only output "DONE" when the count of visited rooms equals the total number of unique rooms discovered. Specifically, when back in the Game room after returning from the Bar, I will check my visited list; since "Craft room" is already in the nodes list but I haven't confirmed all its neighbors are explored, I will prioritize moving to any unvisited neighbor (like checking the 'east' direction again if it leads to a new node) or backtrack to the Craft room to ensure all its connections are mapped before stopping. I will explicitly verify that no new rooms remain reachable before sending the final "DONE" command.
